name: @hobo/data-sqlite
description: HoBo SQLite data engine: the @hobo/data-core SPI over node:sqlite — typed tables from the canonical schema, transactional-outbox change capture, idempotent apply with watermarks, bucketed digests, durable write fences, guarded retire, file-snapshot schema apply — plus the sync dual-run and schema-apply ports @hobo/trails runs its live lanes on.
